author: TeIq
content: Approach: mirror the request_one_page retry shape from label_backfill.rs. Single outer loop attempts 0..=1 (PER_REQUEST_RETRIES=1). On transport Err: log WARN with cause-chain and attempt, continue; on retries exhausted log WARN + return FetchError::Transport. Non-2xx and decode failures stay terminal. Duplicate the reqwest_error_chain helper inline (12 lines) per the brief's option (a). Add one wiremock-based unit test.
